title: DVR open extension identifies with the actual ringed extension
statement: Fix l,E and an open immersion j:X→Y. Every projection-normalized OpenDvrOpenModel O [def-sf-open-dvr-open-model] has derived open extension O.jShriek naturally isomorphic to the actual ringedOpen l E j [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. This compares functors on the ambient derived categories, independently of completeness, Tor bounds and constructibility.

source.place: Maps-used sentence, open-factor normalization: passage from the projection-normalized DVR model to the specified ringed extension.

proof.text: At each finite quotient transpose the model finite restriction map through the sheaf adjunction induced by open postcomposition and base change. Apply the sheafification Hom equivalence to compare this transpose with the canonical constant direct-image map. Naturality of the constant-section unit along the site counit and O.finite_constants make the two maps equal on every constant generator.

Transpose the completed model ring map through the same open sheaf adjunction. The O.ring_projection equations and naturality of the adjunction unit reduce its composite with every finite projection to the equality of step 1. The uniqueness clause of sfCompletedCoefficientMap_existsUnique identifies this completed transpose with the specified completed coefficient direct-image map.

Compose the adjunction from ordinary open restriction to sectionwise direct image with the inverse coefficient equivalence. The modules_functor equality, pushforwardComp and step 2 identify its right adjoint with actual completed-ring module direct image. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies actual integralOrdinaryPull with ordinary restriction followed by O.modules.inverse. Transport the right adjoint of O.modules.functor followed by O.extension.ordinary along that comparison. A second application of left-adjoint uniqueness compares this ordinary extension with PurCompactSupport.openExtension. Localize the ordinary natural isomorphism and compose with mapDerivedCategoryCompIso to obtain O.jShriek isomorphic to ringedOpen. No completeness, boundedness, constructibility or nonempty-open hypothesis occurs.

lean.statement:
theorem openDvr_ringed_identification {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (O : OpenDvrOpenModel l E j) :
    Nonempty (O.jShriek ≅ ringedOpen l E j)
